http.name: Unary gRPC message
http.source: const frame=$response.body; const message=frame[0] ? $utils.ungzip(frame.subarray(5)) : frame.subarray(5); if(!message) throw Error('Cannot decode gzip message'); const output=new Uint8Array(message.length+5); new DataView(output.buffer).setUint32(1,message.length); output.set(message,5); $done({body:output});
